meta.method: Assign each cause/effect node to the existing bechina-based package whose essential nature it shares, considering polarity.

assignments.reason: Kavod (glory of God) is the central goal/result of the entire Torah. The text says כבוד is תיקון העולם and is revealed through the flow of נועם העליון. Its essential nature is the manifest reality of divine glory — the result of the נועם/מוחין process. While kavod functions as an eitza target, its essential nature as the luminous expression of divine order places it in the נועם/מוחין domain of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: תקונם של אלו המחין של חוץ לארץ
assignments.reason: The repair of the exile-minds is an effect produced by כבוד. Its essential nature is the exile-minds themselves — the חובלים / מוחין של חוץ לארץ — which is Package 3. The repair is what happens TO them, but the node describes the exile-minds as the object receiving repair.

The flowing of the supernal pleasantness is the active state of נועם העליון. נועם is the dominant node of Package 1. This is the same essential nature — the divine pleasantness in its flowing/active mode.
נועם העליון is the fuller form of נועם, the dominant node of Package 1. Same essential nature — the supernal pleasantness that is the mind of Eretz Yisrael.

יעקב ויוסף as a compound cause of הולדה: the Torah says 'אלה תולדות יעקב יוסף — עיקר ההולדה על ידי יעקב ויוסף.' יעקב is already in Package 2 (צדקה = יעקב). יוסף is in Package 1 (as a bechina of נועם). The compound node pairs the vessel (יעקב/צדקה) with the content (יוסף/נועם) as a causal unit for הולדה. Since יעקב is the dominant element (צדקה = the vessel that makes הולדה possible), and the compound node functions as the instrument of birth through generosity, it belongs in Package 2.

Charity of Eretz Yisrael is the specific form of צדקה that creates the vessel to receive נועם העליון. Its essential nature is צדקה — the dominant node of Package 2. The qualification 'of Eretz Yisrael' adds specificity but does not change the essential nature.

Becoming a vessel to receive from the supernal pleasantness is the effect of צדקה. Its essential nature is the vessel/receptivity — the quality of נדיבות לב / open-heartedness that defines Package 2. The vessel is the product of generosity, not the content (נועם) it receives.

assignments.node_id: נפתחין שבילין דלבא, ונעשין כלי לקבל שלהובין דרחימותא
assignments.reason: The opening of the heart's pathways and becoming a vessel to receive the loving flames — its essential nature is the open heart (שנפתח ונתנדב הלב is already in Package 2). The pathways of the heart opening IS the process of נדיבות לב. Package 2.

assignments.node_id: הכלי לקבל על ידה מנעם העליון שלהובין דרחימותא
assignments.reason: The vessel to receive through צדקה the flames of love from נועם העליון — same vessel concept as נעשה כלי לקבל. Its essential nature is the receptive instrument created by צדקה. Package 2.
His glory was revealed — the effect of הולדה. Its essential nature is the revelation of divine glory, which is the luminous expression of the נועם/מוחין reality. Package 1.

The human being (אדם) is the cause through whom God's glory is revealed: 'עיקר הכבוד של השם יתברך נתגלה רק על ידי האדם.' The human is the tachlit (purpose) of creation and the vessel through which the נועם/glory manifests. Its essential nature in this Torah is as the bearer of divine consciousness — Package 1.
Variant spelling (with leading space) of נתגלה כבודו. Same concept — the revelation of God's glory through הולדה. Package 1.
Fuller form: 'His blessed glory was revealed.' Same essential nature as נתגלה כבודו — the revelation of divine glory. Package 1.
His blessed glory was revealed and enlarged. Same essential nature — the manifestation of divine glory through the process of הולדה and נועם. Package 1.

analysis_notes.eitza_flow_summary: The Torah's cause/effect chain: (1) צדקה [Pkg 2] → creates vessel → receives נועם העליון [Pkg 1] → produces שלהובין דרחימותא [Pkg 1] → הולדה [Pkg 1] → נתגלה כבודו [Pkg 1]. (2) כבוד [Pkg 1] → תיקון מוחין של חוץ לארץ [Pkg 3]. (3) יעקב ויוסף [Pkg 2] → הולדה [Pkg 1]. The flow runs: Pkg 2 (צדקה/vessel) → Pkg 1 (נועם/הולדה/כבוד) → Pkg 3 (repair of exile-minds).
analysis_notes.duplicate_edges: Edges 2 and 4 are identical (שלהובין דרחימותא → הולדה). Several כבוד-revelation nodes (נתגלה כבודו / נתגלה כבודו יתברך / נתגלה ונתגדל כבודו יתברך) are near-synonyms likely representing the same concept at different points in the text.
analysis_notes.note_on_kavod: כבוד is both the eitza-target of the entire Torah and its thematic center. The text says 'כבוד הוא תיקון העולם' — glory IS the repair of the world. It functions as an eitza-result of הולדה, but its essential NATURE is the luminous divine reality that is the purpose of all creation — placing it in the נועם/מוחין domain rather than as a standalone package.
